name: Inspire Award
description: The most prestigious award given to the team that best embodies the 'challenge' of the FIRST Tech Challenge program.
criteria: Example of Gracious Professionalism® and positive team spirit
Engaging, comprehensive, and well-structured Engineering Portfolio
Robust community outreach and STEM advocacy
Competitive on-field robot performance with solid design principles
teamStrategy: Maintaining a rigorous engineering notebook with daily design updates, CAD breakdowns, and hosting community STEM workshops.

name: Design Award
description: Recognizes industrial design elements of the robot that are both functional and aesthetic.
criteria: Thoughtful and efficient industrial design choices
Clean wiring, robust fasteners, and reliable mechanical layout
Aesthetics matching team branding without sacrificing functionality
teamStrategy: Focusing on CNC-milled structural plates, custom wire-management channels, and sleek aesthetic panels.

name: Control Award
description: Recognizes a team that uses sensors and software to increase robot functionality on the field.
criteria: Sophisticated autonomous routines utilizing encoders, vision, or IMU guidance
Clear documentation of control algorithms (PID, odometry, state machines)
Reliable sensor integration providing a clear competitive edge
teamStrategy: Detailing our custom Road Runner odometry tuning, AprilTag vision alignment, and closed-loop PID controls.

name: Innovate Award
description: Celebrates a team that thinks outside the box and has an innovative, creative, and reliable robot design solution.
criteria: Elegantly designed, unique mechanical or electrical component
Clear conceptual documentation and patent-style description
High reliability and effectiveness during match play
teamStrategy: Showcasing our custom-engineered active intake and precision scoring mechanism with thorough stress-testing data.

name: Connect Award
description: Awarded to the team that most successfully connects with their local community, engineering professionals, and the FIRST family.
criteria: Active collaboration with local STEM professionals and mentors
Networking with other FTC/FRC teams to share resources and knowledge
Demonstrated passion for spreading FIRST awareness outside meetings
teamStrategy: Partnering with local tech companies, mentoring rookie teams, and hosting community robot demo days.

name: Reach Award
description: Celebrates a team that has successfully introduced and recruited new people into FIRST.
criteria: Clear outreach objectives supporting the broader FIRST community
Active recruitment of new students, coaches, mentors, or volunteers with no prior FIRST experience
Creative and evolving approach to outreach and marketing materials
teamStrategy: Tracking concrete 'FIRST conversions' by recruiting new rookie mentors and launching targeted local school STEM sessions.

name: Sustain Award
description: Recognizes a team that has established the leadership, financial resources, and organizational practices for long-term continuity.
criteria: Clear plans for long-term financial sustainability and season planning
Project management competency tracking progress toward sustainability goals
Intentional leadership development processes for preparing future student leaders
teamStrategy: Establishing a robust alumni network for remote mentoring and implementing a multi-tier student leadership handover plan.

name: Think Award
description: Given to the team that best reflects the journey taken through the engineering design process in their portfolio.
criteria: Clear engineering portfolio documenting design iterations and trade-offs
Effective use of CAD, prototyping, and rigorous testing notes
Thorough explanation of mathematical and scientific engineering principles
teamStrategy: Highlighting our iterative CAD models, failure analysis reports, and software testing logs.

name: Judges' Choice Award
description: Given by the judges to a team whose unique efforts, performance, or dynamics merit recognition.
criteria: Unique team characteristics or hurdles overcome during the season
Special standout moments that caught the judges' attention in the pits or field
teamStrategy: Remaining approachable, enthusiastic, and exceptionally helpful to neighboring teams in the pit area.
